payload.title: P3 Image guidelines: profile document in S3 and section image documents
payload.description:
What: the visual style profile and section image overrides follow the same storage; the image resolver's rules do not change.

Files:
- src/papyrus_content/images/profile_store.py: read and write the profile document as a doctrine_document attachment; read the old inline shape (metadata.visualStyle + bodyMarkus) until a site is migrated
- src/papyrus_content/images/profile_handlers.py, visual_style.py: section layer from desk-doctrine-<sectionKey>-visual-style, falling back to NewsroomSection.visualStyle/visualGuidance; the CLI lane reads the section layer too (closes the CLI/door difference noted in docs/image-style-profiles.md)
- docs/image-style-profiles.md (where it lives)
- features_backend/image-profile.feature (new scenarios), features_backend/guidelines-image-sections.feature

Acceptance checks:
- Example images (PPY-6d878b) still resolve from the profile after the move.
- A resolve gives the same effective guidance before and after a site's profile is re-saved in the new shape.
- No new reads per Reference or Story; section layer is one indexed read.

Gherkin scenarios:
- A saved visual style profile keeps its text in S3
- A profile saved in the old shape is still read
- A section image document narrows the site's palette
- A section image document cannot add a source the site does not allow
- A section without an image document falls back to its old visual guidance field
- The command line and the door resolve a section's image guidance the same way

Design: docs/plans/guidelines-as-data.md. Gherkin specs are required and ship in the same PR. Text lives in S3, never inline in DynamoDB; no new GSI; no subscriptions. Style and voice wording is data, never code.
